svg.title: Chengyu of the day: 胸有成竹 (traditional 胸有成竹), xiōng yǒu chéng zhú, “The bamboo is drawn in the mind first”. Know the shape of the change before the first keystroke. The characters write themselves in stroke by stroke, in Simplified and then in Traditional.

g.text: “The bamboo is drawn in the mind first”

in real stroke order · a new one every day
